comment: Node screen presentation (04 W-09, W-11, W-13; D-140n). 'merchant.shelves' is the rail order (the sell shelf shows only while the shopSell setting is on); 'merchant.figure' is the art shown for the merchant (existing enemy art, per 04 W-09 'chosen per data'). 'event.art' maps an event id to the reused registry art of its narrative panel; without an entry the first enemy of a fight the event can start is shown ('event.enemyArt', {id}), else the region's map art ('event.background', {region}; 'event.fallbackBackground' when the art is missing). 'dialogue.speakerArt' is a speaker portrait by its portraitKey ({id}); 'dialogue.playerArt' names the player's figure (the run's portrait). 'legacyDungeon' names a scene's background and floor ({scene}: the catalog scene id whose node range holds the node), the dungeon's map art ({asset}: the dungeon's assetId) and the occupant of a hostile node (its encounter's first enemy, {id}). Every value is an assets/registry.json id or template.
